metadata.domain: AI Vision Perception / ADAS / Computer Vision

evidence.trl_pathway: All three technologies start at TRL 6-7, which is already near-market, and the timelines (2 years for T01, 2 years for T02, instantaneous for T03) are broadly plausible for incremental development; however, T03 completing in 0 quarters (2030-Q1 to 2030-Q1) is unrealistic for any meaningful development work.
evidence.strategic_fidelity: The declared strategy is 시장이익최대 (Market Profit Maximization), which requires near-boom timing and commercialization focus; however, T02 completes 3.25 years after its market boom and T03 completes 1.75 years late, meaning the portfolio systematically misses its profit windows rather than maximizing them.
evidence.competitive_awareness: All three technologies — sensor fusion, synthetic data generation, and on-device optimization — are core to the AI Vision/ADAS domain and represent well-understood competitive battlegrounds; the selection shows solid domain fit with no off-domain drift.
evidence.market_timing: For 시장이익최대, completions should fall within ±0.5 years of market boom; T01 is marginally acceptable at +0.5yr, but T02 misses by 3.25 years and T03 misses by 1.75 years, resulting in a mean error of 1.83 years and systematic late-to-market positioning that undermines the profit-maximization strategy.
evidence.patent_market_convergence: The selected technologies are all active patent areas in the ADAS/computer vision space with known market growth, but there is no explicit evidence in the roadmap of deliberate convergence-zone targeting — the selections appear driven by strategic fit scores rather than patent-market signal intersection.

strengths: All selected technologies are firmly within the AI Vision/ADAS core domain, ensuring competitive relevance and leverageable existing capabilities.
Dependency chain is logically structured (T01→T02→T03) with zero dependency violations, and budget is fully utilized without overspending.
weaknesses: Systematic late-to-market completion: two of three technologies finish well after their respective market boom windows, directly contradicting the 시장이익최대 strategic mandate.
T03 (온-디바이스 모델 최적화) has a zero-duration development window (2030-Q1 to 2030-Q1), which is not credible and suggests a planning artifact rather than a realistic execution plan.
missing_technologies: Transformer-based real-time object detection (e.g., Vision Transformer for ADAS) — high market growth alignment with 2027-2028 boom windows
Edge AI inference accelerator IP — directly enables on-device optimization and has strong patent-market convergence in 2027-2028
Occupancy grid / 3D scene understanding — complements sensor fusion and has near-term (2026-2027) commercialization opportunity
investment_issues: T02 (시뮬레이션 기반 합성 데이터 생성) is rated Tier=Strategic with urgency=5.0 yet its completion misses the market boom by 3.25 years — the high urgency score is inconsistent with a 2-year delayed start after T01.
T03 is classified Tier=High with urgency=3.0 but receives a zero-duration development window, suggesting investment allocation does not translate into actionable development capacity.
No Tier=Core or exploratory investments exist alongside Strategic/High tiers, leaving the portfolio with no hedging mechanism if primary technology timelines slip further.
timing_issues: 시뮬레이션 기반 합성 데이터 생성 completes in 2030-Q1, which is 3.25 years after the 2026-Q4 market boom — the technology arrives long after competitors have captured the market opportunity.
온-디바이스 모델 최적화 completes in 2030-Q1 vs. 2028-Q2 boom, missing peak demand by 1.75 years and rendering the profit-maximization rationale ineffective.
The sequential dependency chain forces T02 and T03 to start late; an overlap or parallel development approach should have been designed to pull completions earlier.
